reason: Sensory descriptions and weighted panel scores of Polygonatum kingianum across steaming cycles; sensory scores are not a measured compositional/physical target.
foods: Polygonatum kingianum (PK) rhizomes steamed with black beans (PK-to-black bean ratio of 4:1)
treatments: raw PK (S): washed, sliced, dried at 60 °C; P1–P9: steamed with black beans at atmospheric pressure for 8 h per cycle, soaked in collected steam condensate for 1.5 h, dried at 60 °C; repeated for a total of nine cycles
methods_quote: black beans were added, and the PK was steamed at atmospheric pressure in a 304 thickened stainless steel steam pot for 8 h, during which the steam condensate was collected throughout the process.
replicates: Eight experienced testers would evaluate 10 groups of PK samples
